$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFMF (AIP France, chart dated 2023-11-30): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Fayence - Tourrettes

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD reserved for radio equipped ACFT (1) Declared distances usables: TODA reduced due to the gauge of track road traffic and/or vegetation adjacent to the RWY strips ends.
TODA: reduced distance, which requires TKOF before the opposite DTHR.
Close attention advised for taxiing outside of RWY.
LDG are difficult with severe winds from NW (mistral).
Severe turbulences due to down-draughts and rotors on AD.
Important glider traffic SR-SS.
Unidirectional RWY 32.
RWY 32 (TKOF and LDG) reserved for gliders.
RWY 10L and 28R reserved for gliders from SR - SS.
When RWY 32 is in use, AEM activity is prohibited.
Simultaneous use of glider RWY and airplane RWY prohibited.
LDG and TKOF are to be delayed if a glider is immobilized closer than 30 m from the common limit of glider RWY and airplane RWY.
Priority to landing gliders.
Mixed RWY 32 markings only made of side marks (beacons missing).

Altitude loss areas: Existence of two glider descending areas with a radius of 1 km centered respectively for RWY 10L and RWY 28R at 1600 m in the 330° and 030° of the identification circle of the field: "FAYENCE" respectively named "Zone Camandre" and "Zone Chautard".
Noise pollution: Limitation to two RWY patterns for non-based ACFT; "Low height" RWY pattern prohibited for non-based.
Over aerodrome at 2500 ft AAL for any ACFT before integration in their traffic pattern – Except activation of area 6954 (activity known on 119.050 Mhz).
Helicopter activity: "ground work" prohibited unless waived for twin-engined aircraft for specific "engine failure" exercises.
The exercise intent must be sent by e-mail to chefpilote@aapca.net with a prior notice of at least 24 hours.
This request may be subject to limitation or delay by the Chief Pilot according to the activity scheduled on the aerodrome site.
AEM activity (NR 9705) on AD: 500 ft ASFC.
Aerobatic (NR 6954) over AD: 2700 ft AMSL / FL 055
HJ - Reserved for gliders.
A winch for gliders (NR 984) on RWY10L/28R or 14/32 limited to 2250 ft AMSL, SR-SS, transmitted on the A/A FREQ and rotating light mounted on the winch.

During winching: on the RWY 10L/28R: RWY32 prohibited and RWY for gliders 10L/28R prohibited for any other use.; on the RWY 14/32: RWY10/28 prohibited and RWY32 prohibited for any other use.; all ACFT must proceed overhead AD at 2000 ft AAL before joining circuit.; aerobatics over aerodrome suspended.

Paramotors: Before all activities at Fayence Airport, any paramotor user must sign the Chart of good practices of paramotor pilots with association of Fayence's paramotors, following e-mail adress: club.paramoteur.fayence@gmail.com The activity takes place only in the configuration facing the East part of the RWY (QFU 10 in use).
Existence of 2 zones outside easements specifically created within the aerodrome right-of-way for paramotors activities.
Zone 1: engine warm-up and wing pre-flights area.
Zone 2: installation just before TKOF.
The paramotor circuit is located South of RWY 10R/28L at 500 ft AAL.
Remote controlled flights: prior contact with the operator.
Activity prohibited if RWY 32 in use.
